text:
Maria H: Heads-up — since ~09:15 eu-west GPU pools triggered multiple saturation alerts but node_gpu_util is low. Queue depth + batch panels spike briefly. Anyone else seeing this?
Aj Patel: yep, saw it. Grafana spikes on queue_depth_inflight for eu-west-pool-2 at 09:14:30, but node_gpu_util is sitting ~15%. :thinking:
Chris: my quick guess is the egress proxy is causing retries/drops which inflate queues (requests pile up waiting for successful egress).
Devon: I noticed a small nginx burst of upstream 502s around 09:14. Could be correlated.
Li Wei: I pulled a quick correlation:
```
# PromQL: 5m windows aligned
sum(rate(redwood_queue_depth{region="eu-west"}[1m])) by (pool)
/ sum(rate(node_gpu_utilization{region="eu-west"}[1m])) by (pool)
```
looks noisy when nginx upstream 5xx spikes.
ops-bot: Alert: gpu_pool_saturation fired for eu-west-pool-2 (09:15:05)
Aj Patel: To reduce noise we should avoid alerting solely on raw queue depth. Add a derived metric that factors batch size.
Maria H: proposal: effective_concurrency = queue_depth / (1 + avg_batch_size). That way big batches don't make the pool look saturated when it's just batching efficiency.
Li Wei: agree. also add smoothing and outlier suppression in Grafana: use a 3m moving_average and drop top 99.9th quantile spikes. Example snippet:
```
moving_average(sum(rate(redwood_queue_depth[1m])) by (pool), 3m)
```
and for batch size: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))
Chris: Another pragmatic guard: correlate proxy_5xx_rate with queue spikes and mute alerts when proxy_5xx_rate > 0.3 for 2m. Most false positives follow proxy issues.
Devon: we should also add a synthetic probe that runs through the proxy and measures per-request GPU latency. e.g.:
```
curl -sS -H "x-test-probe: true" https://eu-west-proxy.internal/ping -D - | grep X-GPU-Latency
```
store the probe in Prometheus via pushgateway or blackbox-exporter.
Aj Patel: +1. For alerts I suggest: fire only if (effective_concurrency > threshold) AND (proxy_5xx_rate < 0.3) for 3m. Also add a derivative-based debounce to avoid instant flaps.
Maria H: can you draft the alert rule? create a variant: warn at 60% effective_concurrency, critical at 80%. Include annotation to check proxy metrics and recent pod restarts.
Aj Patel: will do. I'll open a dashboard/alert PR and a short runbook. Proposed runbook items:
- Check proxy 5xx and request latencies
- Check recent pod restarts / OOMs
- Inspect avg_batch_size and batch_size_p50/p95
- Check node_gpu_util and per-request GPU time
- Run synthetic probe and test flow through proxy
- If proxy is root cause, escalate to networking and mute alerts for 10m
Li Wei: also add a Grafana panel for effective_concurrency and annotate the chart with proxy_5xx events so it's obvious.
Chris: small follow-up: add a percentile-based alert suppression to ignore single-point spikes from synthetic probes or CI storms.
Maria H: thanks everyone — Aj assigned. I'll ping networking if PR shows proxy as the culprit. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: Created alert rule PR #428 in infra/observability (Aj Patel).
Aj Patel: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/observability/pulls/428 — draft rules + dashboard panels. Please review.
Devon: quick qa: deployed probe job to eu-west staging. will watch for 30m and report.
Maria H: closing loop: if no further false alarms after smoothing + effective_concurrency, we can roll the new rules to prod tomorrow AM.
Chris: :ok_hand:
